en.p: A point $\mathrm{P}$ starts from the origin at time $t=0$ and moves along a number line. For a real number $k$, the velocity $v(t)$ of point $\mathrm{P}$ at time $t\ (t\ge 0)$ is
Which of the statements in <Statements> are correct? Choose all that apply. [4 points]

box: a. If $k=0$, the position of point $\mathrm{P}$ at time $t=1$ is $\dfrac{13}{3}$.
b. If $k=3$, point $\mathrm{P}$ changes its direction of motion exactly once after it starts.
c. If $k=5$, the distance traveled by point $\mathrm{P}$ from time $t=0$ to $t=2$ is $3$.
